FactoryScript.Description: Configures a device based on project file

FactoryTask.description: Erases data flash. This can be used to get your device back to it’s original unconfigured “factory” state.
FactoryTask.Technical_Description: This task will send the device to ROM mode, erase data flash, optionally write the pflash checksum, instruct the ROM to execute the program, and then wait for the device to come online.

FactoryTaskArgument.Name: write_pflash_checksum
FactoryTaskArgument.Description: Write program flash checksum? If true on device restart the program will be executed. [Default: True]

FactoryTaskArgument.Name: write_aa_pattern
FactoryTaskArgument.Description: write_aa_pattern? If true an 0xAA pattern (and if false, an 0xFF pattern) will be written to data flash. [Default: False]

FactoryTask.description: Resets the device via PMBus and waits a default amount of time.

Configure all parameters on device based on project file from Fusion Power Design GUI.
FactoryTask.Technical_Description: Takes project file and identifies the set of parameters to take from a project file based on the config_value. There is also the option to store to the device after the configuration is completed. A parameter check is done to compare which parameters differ between the device and project file. A write is then done on those select differences. However if you set force_write_of_all to true then it will write every parameter from the project file to the device.

FactoryTaskArgument.Name: file_location
FactoryTaskArgument.Description: The project file that contains the device configuration desired.

FactoryTaskArgument.Name: store_to_flash
FactoryTaskArgument.Description: Set to true to store the newly configured parameters to flash. [Default: True]

FactoryTaskArgument.Name: device_choice
FactoryTaskArgument.Description: Choose which device setting you want to use to locate device in project file.

FactoryTaskArgument.Name: force_write_of_all
FactoryTaskArgument.Description: Set to true if you want all project file parameters to be written to the device even if they are the same. [Default: False]

FactoryTask.description: Resets the device via PMBus and waits a default amount of time.

FactoryTask.Technical_Description: Displays status in log before and after call to clear faults on device.

FactoryTask.description: Clears the logged faults on device as opposed to faults.
Resets the device via PMBus and waits a default amount of time.
